scientific_integrity: Analytical Fourier proof for all dimensions; independent finite numerical testing is not claimed. A standalone exact integer checker corroborates dimensions 3 through 9, but finite verification does not replace the theorem proof.
scientific_limitations: Theorem concerns only unweighted folded cubes in dimensions at least three under the adjacency-Hamiltonian continuous-time Cesàro average. It does not classify all distance-regular graphs or instantaneous/randomized-time mixing. Published statements with broader implicit coverage remain a possible literature-overlap risk.
title: Exact average-mixing spectrum, parity nullity, and spectral gap of folded hypercubes
